description: This file contains functions for generating an XML test summary report in a C project. It includes functions to initialize and shutdown the report, and to write various XML elements representing test suites, test cases, failures, and skipped tests.

methods.name: int clar_summary_close_tag(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * tag,int indent)
methods.description: Closes an XML tag with indentation, writing the end tag to the summary file.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testsuite(struct clar_summary * summary,int idn,const char * name,time_t timestamp,int test_count,int fail_count,int error_count)
methods.description: Creates a test suite XML element with metadata such as ID, name, timestamp, and test counts.

methods.name: int clar_summary_testcase(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * name,const char * classname,double elapsed)
methods.description: Creates a test case XML element with name, class, and elapsed time.

methods.name: int clar_summary_failure(struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)
methods.description: Writes a failure element in the XML report, including a message and description.

methods.name: int clar_summary_skipped(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Indicates a skipped test case in the report.

methods.name: struct:clar_summary * clar_summary_init(const char * filename)
methods.description: Initializes the summary report, opening the file and allocating the summary structure.

methods.name: int clar_summary_shutdown(struct clar_summary * summary)
methods.description: Finalizes the report by closing all remaining tags, writing data to the file, and freeing resources.

ctags.signature: (struct clar_summary * summary,const char * type,const char * message,const char * desc)
